claude.rationale: The structure folds Convergys directly into an existing operating subsidiary (Concentrix CVG Corporation) that the parties described as being in the same customer-engagement/BPO line of business, so the customer-facing product (T4, ~110,000 employees serving clients' customers) and the operational processes that deliver it (T5) moved together as an intact going concern rather than product-without-process — no product/process mismatch (gap_45=0). No transitional-services or carve-out agreement was identified because none was needed; the operations and their running organization crossed the boundary together into a single surviving entity, so T5 was not re-engineered apart from its people/organization (gap_56=0). T6 is coded partial because the board resigned and was replaced and the CEO's departure/separation terms were set pre-signing, indicating people-tier discontinuity at the top, but the operating workforce transferred with the business. Because both coded gaps are 0, gap_mitigated is NA.
